newsitem.title: USA: CompUSA to open two stores in Texas Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: CompUSA to open two stores in Texas Sept 13.

text.p: CompUSA Inc said Thursday it would open a store in Lubbock and another in Plano, Texas on September 13.
The company said the size of the store in Lubbock will be 19,000 square feet, while the other in Plano will be 30,300 square feet.
It is the first store that CompUSA opens in Lubbock and the seventh one in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex.
The company, a computer retailer, said the two stores follow its latest prototype with CompKids and Software Sampler areas as well as a training center.
